title: Hidden UFO side of Operation Paperclip

tellings.quote: But there's this like other side of it that a lot of it dealt with the UFO, UAP issue in earnest.

plain: Operation Paperclip was the American effort after the Second World War to bring German scientists to the United States, and according to the former US intelligence officer David Grusch, it had a hidden second side that dealt seriously with UFOs. Grusch says much of it "dealt with the UFO, UAP issue in earnest" (UAP is the government's term for unidentified objects in the sky), and he ties this to the German rocket engineers Wernher von Braun and Arthur Rudolph. He passes this on as something he was told, not something he saw himself. If true, it would mean the US was working on the UFO question from the very start of the postwar era.
